subject: Air freight quote to TLV
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest air freight option to TLV (Tel Aviv, IL), including the truck you’d arrange from our site in 41603 (Moenchengladbach), Germany, to the departure airport?

The shipment is 12 pieces of automotive sensors, with a gross weight of 646 kg and a total volume of 3.71 cbm. It’ll be ready for pickup on 2026-11-24.

Thanks for checking!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

classification.reasoning: The customer is making a new request for an all-in air freight quote for a specified shipment.
